messages:
maria (AE): quick heads-up — ProofPoint trial asks for a 2-week POC for smart email triage. Main asks: VPC + SOC2 answers, stay under ~$6k for POC infra, target p95 latency <=300ms, sustain up to 50 req/s peak. can SE/SRE sketch capacity + cost roughs before tomorrow's presales call? cc @lee (SE) @sam (SRE)
lee (SE): thanks — couple clarifying qs: 1) avg input tokens? 2) are responses streamed or single shot? 3) do they need on-prem/private plane (they said VPC) or can we host? 4) quality bar / eval set?
maria (AE): they said ~200 tokens in, ~100 tokens out avg. streaming not required. must be in customer VPC (private deployment). they can provide ~2k sample emails + 200 labeled for eval. quality bar: triage accuracy (label match) ~>85% on those labels.
lee (SE): ok with those numbers: rough back-of-envelope: avg tokens/request = 300. 50 req/s -> 15k tokens/s sustained at peak. With optimized runtime + batching/cache, throughput depends heavily on model size. options to propose: 
- Quality-first: 70B quantized model (best quality) — much higher GPU count and cost, likely not fit within $6k POC budget.
- Balanced: 13B quantized (recommended first pass) — better throughput/cost tradeoff; expect O(1-2k tokens/s per A100-class GPU depending on batch config and kernel choices. rough GPU count: 6-12 A100s to cover 15k tokens/s without aggressive batching; with continuous batching and prefix cache might drop to 3-6.
- Fast/cheap: 7B family — 2-4 A100s likely enough, lowest latency, but might miss quality bar for some intents.
These are estimates; final numbers after a quick benchmark with their sample set.
sam (SRE): for Private deployment notes: VPC peering + our agent in their subnet needed. KMS/HSM for keys, and we need to confirm network egress policy (no external model pulls). provisioning time: 2-4 business days for infra + VPN/K8s hooks, then ~1 day for model build and smoke tests. If they want strict SOC2 evidence, we’ll need their security questionnaire — we can attach standard SOC2 + data flow diagram.
olivia (sales-ops): budget-wise: $6k/month is tight for large GPU footprint. if they accept 13B quantized and we use burst capacity plus aggressive batching, we might keep POC infra costs ~ $5-9k for the 2-week window (depending on spot vs reserved pricing). recommend asking customer for a short-term uplift to $10k if we need more headroom.
lee (SE): proposed concrete plan for tomorrow's call (short bullets): 
- Ask customer to share 2k sample emails + 200 labeled dev set by EOD today.
- Confirm VPC peering details and CISO contact.
- Run a 24-48h micro-benchmark (their samples) to pick model variant (7B/13B/70B).
- Start with 13B quantized in their VPC: target config = 4x A100 (initial) with autoscale to 8 if metrics show saturation. configure batching window 20-50ms, prefix cache enabled.
- Success criteria: p95 latency <=300ms (for 90% of traffic), triage accuracy >=85% on labeled set, infra costs <=$10k for POC period.
- Deliverable: final report with latency/cost per 1M tokens, recommended model and runbook for production.
maria (AE): solid. i'll push the ask on the sales call. quick ask for the presales deck: can you drop a 1-slide cost/throughput table? 
lee (SE): will do — table will show 3 scenarios (7B / 13B / 70B) with ballpark GPUs, expected tokens/sec per GPU, estimated infra cost for 2-week POC, and risk notes. i'll attach after the call.
sam (SRE): one more ops item: retention/PII — confirm retention window, if they need message redaction before storage, and who owns logs. we enforce audit logs to their KMS. also we need their requirement for vulnerability scanning of our agent image.
maria (AE): noted. i'll collect retention + CISO contact.
deploy-bot: scheduled infra-request #PR-4821 (private-poc-proofpoint) queued — estimated provisioning ETA 72h once we approve size. :rocket:
olivia (sales-ops): next steps: 1) 30m sync right after presales call to lock model choice, 2) customer to share samples + security questionnaire, 3) SE to drop slide + quick perf numbers within 24h. I'll block the slot. :calendar:
lee (SE): thanks — will prepare the slide and an initial benchmark script. if they can provide a small binary of their tokenizer or confirm UTF8 plain text, that speeds things up.
maria (AE): perfect — talk to them in 30. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
